title: Persona team for global orchestrator sessions
summary: Turns global orchestrator sessions into a team of personas that watch the installation from different aspects (security, operations, reliability, quality, design, product, cost, documentation), each with a versioned charter, an honest character sheet, a budget carved from the workspace token limit, a configurable reporting obligation, its own feed and management page. Two manager personas decide within standing grants; a weekly magazine and a presenter deck rank every item by a 0 to 100 importance number computed from impact, urgency and confidence with fact floors. A dedicated operations warden watches backups and the security posture, so a missing backup or an expired credential always ranks high. Personas run as short sessions of their own principal on runner hosts, scheduled by the Watcher sweep. Twelve decisions with recommended options, diagrams, mockups, light and dark evidence captures, a phased plan and twelve implementation cards.

openDecisions.question: What a persona is and where the catalogue lives
openDecisions.recommendation: Versioned descriptor in backend/Policies/personas plus workspace activation through the API, step-up activation, one shadow period.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Prompt-only skills, settings records only, files per project.

openDecisions.question: Stats
openDecisions.recommendation: Owner-set attributes with named effects, derived record with denominators, rank as eligibility only.

openDecisions.question: Budgets
openDecisions.recommendation: Persona pool of 10 % of ModelTokensPerWeek (1.2M without limit) with per-persona allowances; stubs and model-free floor items on exhaustion; pause at 80 % workspace use; same-class fallback or wait.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Share the Watcher contingent; per-subscription slices.

openDecisions.question: Activation and scheduling
openDecisions.recommendation: Persona principal sessions on runner hosts, scheduled by the Watcher sweep with coalescing; at most two per workspace; card work first.

openDecisions.question: Reports, feed and page
openDecisions.recommendation: Typed PersonaItemV1 on the Agent Message Bus (participant kind Persona) plus application store; configurable obligation with fixed templates; Team page and persona page.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Free text in Dossiers; a new event stream.

openDecisions.question: Manager roles
openDecisions.recommendation: Chief of staff and budget steward with bounded T1 rights, attention lease, 24-hour undo; T2 stays with the owner.

openDecisions.question: Magazine
openDecisions.recommendation: Weekly Studio Weekly issue, deterministic layout plus one editor call, HTML and PDF export, sending off by default.

openDecisions.question: Importance numbers
openDecisions.recommendation: 0 to 100 from impact × urgency × confidence with fact floors, ±15 manager adjustment, owner acknowledgement.

openDecisions.question: Presentations
openDecisions.recommendation: Presenter persona with deck.json, weekly and monthly decks, style guide tokens in both themes, HTML and PDF.

openDecisions.question: Safety
openDecisions.recommendation: Principal per persona, catalogued persona operations, untrusted content only for own publication, managers on typed fields, team stop plus SM-2.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Owner or operator identity; read-only personas.

openDecisions.question: Evaluation
openDecisions.recommendation: Value panel, misses, owner rating, rule-based suggestions, before/after by revision; the owner decides.

openDecisions.question: Starter catalogue and the operations aspect
openDecisions.recommendation: Eight aspect personas with a dedicated operations warden, presenter, two managers; warden and cost controller start active.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Reliability takes operations; everything active at once.
